why: Multiple sources (Wikipedia's own Demazure conjecture article, Grokipedia) state the conjecture was proved for classical groups by Lakshmibai-Musili-Seshadri (1979) and extended to all reductive algebraic groups by Littelmann (1998) via the Littelmann path model; this resolution appears to be pre-snapshot and the Wikipedia list entry appears stale.
